whatThisFileIs: An R1 authorship claim for the AFC-330 superset fallback in .github/workflows/ci.yml (Gap 1 under AFC-172): when the provenance range built from github.event.before does not resolve (dangling before-SHA after the backup-snapshot history rewrite), the step falls back to full HEAD history and says so in the log, instead of exiting 2 with no verdict.
basis: Gap 1 runner failure #2 on AFC-172: run 37861662613, job Compliance-path dirty guard, step Compliance-path commit provenance exited 2 with `cannot resolve revision range '11a66384a579685c1c1a3119e2676a93c03e2598..HEAD'` because the before-SHA is dangling on a fresh runner checkout (verified locally: the object exists in the shared workspace but merge-base --is-ancestor against 21a3092 fails, so it is reachable from no ref on main). Exit 2 is correct fail-closed behaviour; the defect is the missing fallback in the CI wiring, not in scripts/dirty-path-guard.sh, which is untouched by this change. The fallback checks MORE commits (full HEAD history), never fewer, so it cannot hide a violation the push range would have reported.
verificationRecorded: MEASURED in a clean worktree at origin/main 21a3092. scripts/dirty-path-guard.sh --self-test: 49 ok / 0 FAIL / exit 0. Old behaviour reproduced with a nonexistent SHA: --check-commit <dangling>..HEAD exits 2 with no verdict. New step logic with the same dangling range: prints the fallback lines and exits 1 with 31 named COMMIT blocks (honest red, as the issue's known follow-on predicts). A resolvable range (HEAD~3..HEAD) takes no fallback. The step still passes exactly ONE positional argument to --check-commit, so the CHECK_COMMIT_MAX_ARGS=1 dispatcher contract and self-test assertion 11e are unaffected (11e green in the self-test run).

r2Review.note: CTO review recorded two ways: Reviewed-by trailer on landed commit 6c0cc29 (mechanical R2, independent of the Coder author under Rule 1) and this reviews[] entry (record). reviews.findings: Wiring-only change: 15-line fallback block in the provenance step of .github/workflows/ci.yml; guard untouched; fail-closed default kept (exit 2 on unreadable tree); fallback is a SUPERSET (full HEAD history) so it cannot hide a push-range violation; single positional arg to --check-commit kept (CHECK_COMMIT_MAX_ARGS=1). Verified: self-test 64 ok / 0 FAIL / exit 0; dangling range takes fallback, resolvable range does not; check-commit on 6c0cc29 alone exits 0 (R1 ok, R2 ok via trailer). Rebased onto origin/main 693699b (PR #1 rewrite); ADR-uniqueness gates preserved.
